component.name: Carbide Silica
component.summary: Explorer for Verus and PBaaS chains

description.p: Carbide Silica shows the data of a Verus node as charts and diagrams. Each page also gives the exact figures. The app is a front end for Carbide, the terminal explorer by alexenglish, and uses the same RPC client, decoding and cache.
The app is read-only. It does not read a wallet. It cannot create, sign or send a transaction.

ul.li: A transaction page starts with a statement in words and shows the flow of the amounts.
The Charts page shows five measures on one time axis with one cursor.
An identity page shows each version and who holds the keys.
The Dashboard shows the recent staked and mined blocks.

description.p: The app needs access to the RPC port of a Verus node. It reads the node configuration from ~/.komodo/VRSC/VRSC.conf by default.
The first Linux release. It has all pages of the macOS app.
